categories.severe: variance < severe_max: strong blur indication, manual review required
categories.probable: severe_max <= variance < probable_max: likely blur, manual review required
categories.possible: probable_max <= variance < possible_max: mild blur indication, review if other flags present
categories.clear: variance >= possible_max: no blur indication from this heuristic alone

blur.note: Thresholds are screening heuristics only. Small ingredient images and smooth backgrounds naturally produce low variance, so a single universal threshold must not be treated as ground truth.

compression.note: file_size_bytes / (width * height); a low value is a screening hint for heavy JPEG compression, not proof.

algorithms.text_heavy_candidate: High Canny edge density with many horizontally aligned edge rows; no OCR was performed.
algorithms.packaging_candidate: High edge density combined with low mean HSV saturation, consistent with printed packaging; no packaging model was used.
algorithms.possible_watermark: High local contrast confined to image corners while overall edge density is low; no watermark model was used.
algorithms.no_clear_subject_candidate: Very low edge density and very low saturation, consistent with a blank or near-uniform frame.

duplicate_detection.note: pHash and dHash are perceptual similarity estimates. Candidate groups require human review and must not be automatically merged.

flags.low_resolution: Minimum side is below low_min_side; screening only, not automatic rejection.
flags.very_low_resolution: Minimum side is below very_low_min_side; likely unsuitable for training without careful review.
flags.unusually_large_dimensions: Total pixels exceed unusually_large_pixels; may need resizing strategy review.
flags.possible_blur: Laplacian variance falls in probable/possible blur ranges.
flags.severe_blur: Laplacian variance falls in the severe blur range.
flags.highly_compressed: Bytes-per-pixel is below the configured threshold.
flags.unexpected_mode: Decoded image mode is not in the expected_modes list.
flags.invalid_dimensions: Decoded width or height is non-positive or disagrees with the Step 6 inventory.
flags.corrupted_image: The file could not be decoded or Pillow verify() failed; may be truncated.
flags.missing_source_file: The path recorded in the Step 6 inventory no longer exists.
flags.text_heavy_candidate: Edge-pattern heuristic suggests text-heavy content; no OCR performed.
flags.packaging_candidate: Edge/colour heuristic suggests printed packaging; no packaging model used.
flags.possible_watermark: Corner-contrast heuristic suggests an overlay; no watermark model used.
flags.no_clear_subject_candidate: Low edge and colour variation suggest no clearly visible ingredient.
flags.manual_visual_review_required: At least one screening flag was raised; a human must inspect the image before use.
